wholePhysicalScope: The named native theatre outline establishes the map placement. The theatre operator identifies the Ziller Building and the original Qualla photograph establishes the principal facade.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the Ziller Building silhouette and arched colonnade.
limitations: The principal Ziller Building only. Separate venues and neighboring buildings are outside scope.
Published measurements of facade ornament, rear openings and roof heights were unavailable. Secondary elevations and fine ornament are approximate.
